perpetualsnow.title: Perpetual Snow
perpetualsnow.option.enabled.desc: Turns perpetual snow on or off completely.
perpetualsnow.option.nether.desc: Snow in the Nether (off by default).
perpetualsnow.option.end.desc: Snow in the End (off by default).
perpetualsnow.option.amount.desc: How visible the snow is. It does not change the number of flakes - that is fixed by the weather radius. Keep it low for a clear view while PvPing.
perpetualsnow.option.flakeSize.desc: Size and thickness of the flakes. 1.0 = vanilla.
perpetualsnow.option.opacity.desc: How solid the flakes look. 1.0 = fully visible.
perpetualsnow.option.fallSpeed.desc: How fast the flakes fall. 1.0 = vanilla.
perpetualsnow.option.drift.desc: How much the flakes drift sideways. 0 = straight down.
perpetualsnow.option.noSkyDarken.desc: Keeps sky and fog bright instead of dimming them for the fake weather.
perpetualsnow.option.muteRainSounds.desc: Silences the weather and rain sounds.
perpetualsnow.option.throughCeilings.des: Always makes snow fall around you, no matter what is above (barriers, glass, stone, high or low arena roofs). Meant for PvP in enclosed arenas. Off = only under open sky.
perpetualsnow.option.fullBright.desc: Always renders the snow at full brightness, even under ceilings. Needed so snow stays visible inside arenas.
